title: Origin story: Jademask
description: Jademask was an actor who played a thousand roles and lost track of which face was hers — until she carved a jade mask that holds them all. She wears the faces of the dead to settle their unfinished business, and the faces of the living to teach them who they are. The mask never comes off now; it doesn't need to.

title: Power ranking: Jademask
description: Powers: Her masks channel the dead truly; She becomes the role — completely; The jade holds a thousand faces.

title: Stamina feats: Jademask
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Played through plague and war; Wore grief for decades.

title: Crossover notes: Jademask
